title: test_user_authentication_login_profile_logout_flow
description: Verify that users can successfully log in with valid credentials, retrieve their authenticated profile, and log out, ensuring session management works correctly.

title: test_user_management_create_user_with_admin_session
description: Verify that administrators can create new user records with valid data and that the new user appears in the user list.

title: test_rfid_attendance_logging_with_valid_and_invalid_uid
description: Verify that posting a valid RFID UID records attendance successfully and that an unknown or unregistered UID returns an appropriate error.

title: test_school_fees_payment_retrieve_and_process
description: Verify that authenticated users can retrieve outstanding bills and process payments correctly, and that invalid payment attempts are rejected.

title: test_lms_assignments_submit_and_grade_homework
description: Verify that students can submit homework for assignments and teachers can grade submissions, including validation of authentication and input correctness.

title: test_cbt_exam_start_save_answer_and_complete
description: Verify that students can start a CBT exam session with a valid token, save answers during the exam, and complete the exam session successfully.
